result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority, the same order the sales-rep list uses.

The change is one query in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (`listOpenSupportTicketsInRegion`, around line 10021). I replaced `ORDER BY t.opened_date, t.id` with the same `CASE` priority ordering the sales-rep query uses, and updated the doc comment to match. Closed tickets and other regions are still excluded.

The only caller is `RegionManagerService`, so the overview picks up the new order without other changes. `RegionManagerTest`, `TicketsPerRegionTest` and `TicketsPerProductTest` pass (9 tests). I did not add a test for the example ordering in the task. Nothing is committed.
